comment: Anchor 1.1.2's own mocha template ships `types: [mocha, chai]`, lib es2015, commonjs, target es6, esModuleInterop. This is that shape with four deliberate differences: `node` is in types (tests/xmrj_devnet_e2e.ts reads the .so sizes and the ANCHOR_* env vars, both of which need the node types), lib/target are es2020, strict + noEmit are on so `npm run typecheck` is a real gate rather than a build step, and `include` covers tools/ as well as tests/ so the stress harness (tools/xmrj_loadtest.ts) is typechecked by the same gate that guards the suite.
